memory_update.text: PLPC should be retained for Layer 2 as a narrow, underfollowed transmission-hardware candidate with evidence needed on backlog quality, order timing versus transmission construction, and raw-material margin sensitivity.

POWL should be retained as a switchgear/custom electrical-distribution candidate, but the key falsification risk is that growth remains tied to lumpy oil, gas, LNG, and petrochemical capex rather than durable utility/data-center electrification demand.
AMSC is a lower-confidence but interesting power-quality candidate; require proof that D-VAR/STATCOM and grid products are material, recurring, and margin-accretive rather than episodic project wins.

Dry-type transformer pure-play exposure is still incomplete in the US-listed universe; Hammond Power appears relevant from external context but needs separate verification of US listing/OTC investability and primary filings before inclusion.

summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the grid/power-conversion equipment node using a two-lane funnel. Reference lane includes Hubbell as a scaled utility/electrical equipment anchor. Underfollowed lane prioritizes Preformed Line Products, Powell Industries, and American Superconductor as narrower or less obvious beneficiaries tied to transmission hardware, custom switchgear/electrical distribution systems, and grid power-quality/reactive-compensation equipment.
